effect.reason: No Trigger watches a player searching a library: the trigger list has no searches event, and CantSearchLibraries is the only record that knows about searching at all, so "whenever an opponent searches their library" cannot be said and the gain-life-and-draw half has no event to hang on.
effect.text: Whenever an opponent searches their library, you gain 1 life and draw a card.

effect.reason: No Trigger record watches a player searching a library (CR 701.19): the list has Scries, Surveils, Mills and the rest but nothing for a search, and there is no unsupported Trigger, so the whole triggered ability is marked here and the StaticAbility is only the slot that can carry the marker. It needs a SearchesLibrary(who) trigger; the effect half, GainLife 1 then Draw 1, is already sayable.
